name: Weights & Biases
desc: Platform for building, evaluating, and debugging AI apps
desc_zh: 用于构建、评测和排查 AI 应用的平台
solves: You changed the prompt and the output got worse, and nobody kept the run that proved it. Every version is tracked, side by side.
solves_zh: 你改了 prompt，结果变差了，却没人留下能证明这一点的运行记录。每个版本都记录下来，并排放着。
best_for: When you need to prove which prompt or model version actually produced a result.
best_for_zh: 当你要证明某个结果究竟是由哪个 prompt 或哪版模型产生时。
